text: Ryari ihinduka rikomeye kubera ko ico gihe ibihugu bikomeye vy'i Buraya bitosubiye kurwana vyitwaje idini. Ya Ntambara y'imyaka mirongo itatu yobaye yo ntambara ya nyuma yitirirwa idini.
Ico gisata gikunda gukoreshwa cane n'abunguruza ibintu n'amato, harimwo amato yo kwinezereza, hamwe n'ingendo zikeneye ibiharuro hamwe n' ijwi vya kure.
Mu gihe c'urugamba rwo guharanira ukwikura rwatunganijwe n'umuhari wa Mau, ikoraniro ry'abantu batekanye ryabereye mu gisagara ryavuyemwo iyiciwa ry'umukuru kizigenza Tupua Tamasese Lealofi wa 3.
Agace kabereyemwo iryo sanganya katowe uno musi kandi ntivyoroshe kuhagera ku buryo abapolisi babiri bururukijwe muri iryo shamba ngo baje muri ako gace n'amaguru kurondera abarokotse.
Inyuma y'imyaka nk'ibihumbi bitatu, mu 1610, umuhinga w'ivyo mu kirere w'Umutaliyano yitwa Galileo Galilei yarakoresheje itarubindi arabona yuko ishusho ya Venisi igenda irahinduka, cokimwe n'ukwezi.
Ingendo zo kwidagagadura abantu benshi bazi ni ingendo zijanye no gutembera.
Ukwiruka ni urukino ruzimbutse; ariko, hari abantu benshi babesha ku buryo bukenewe kugira ngo umuntu arwitabire.
Steve Jobs, umuyobozi mukuru w'ishirahamwe Apple, igihe yahishura iyo telefone yo mu bwoko bwa iPhone, yuriye kuri podiyumu aca akura nya telefone mu mufuko w'ikoboyi yari yambaye.
Kare ikigo kimenyesha amakuru co mu Bushinwa citwa Xinhua catangaje ko hari indege yari yanyurujwe.
Amahiganwa mato mato hamwe n' imipira bishobora navyonyene kuzobonwa aha mu bindi bihe vy' umwaka.

Mubihugu bimwe bimwe vyashize hamwe, nka Reta Zunze Ubumwe hamwe na Canada, ikori kumushahara rirakurwako hompi kurwego rw'ishirahamwe no kurwego rwo mukibano, kuburyo urugero n'ibice vy'amakori birashobora guhinduka kuva mukarere ku akandi.
Mu bisanzwe, Renaissance yagize impinduka idasanzwe mu nzira zo kwiga n'uguhanahana ubumenyi.
Ibihere biryana mu maso n’ibihere bisanzwe vyose biguma mu vyari bikivuka. Biramenyereye kuba mu vyari vyazo canke mu nzu y’igikoko canke umuntu.
Imishamirano itanguye, Ubwongereza bwaciye bufatira ibihano Ubudagi mu vy'amato.
Tuvyita ivuka ry'ubwoko. Ivuka ry'ubwoko ni ingaruka itobura gushika kandi riri mu bintu bihambaye cane bigize ihindagurika ry'ibinyabuzima.
Umushoferi w'ikamyo, afise imyaka 64, ntiyakoremetse muri iryo senyerana.
Ariko rero, abashoferi barakunda kwitwara neza; ivyo bigatuma uruja n’uruza rworoha kandi rushobora kwigwa hakoreshejwe ibiharuro.

Ariko Icegera Cambere John Howard yavuze ko iyo nteguro ariyo gukingira gusa inyubakwa z´ibitaro kugira ntiziteshwe agaciro na Leta ya Tasmaniya, mu gutanga ayarengako imiliyoni 45 z´amadolari ya Ostraliya.

Vyinshi muri ivyo bigo vy´abihebeye Imana biratanga ibitenge ku bagore baje batiteguye, ariko iyo uzanye icawe, na cane cane igifise amabara ayagayaga, uzobona umupadiri canke umubikira ku muryango akumwenyurira.
Ama pound y' Abongereza azokwemerwa mubisanzwe ahariho hose mumazinga hamwe ni karata z' ingurane za Stanley hamwe nama dolari ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe nayo nyene kenshi aremewe.
Aranavuga ahubwo ko ubwo bushobozi bwo gutahura imyigenzo y'abantu bushobora kuba buri no mu bikoko nk'imbwa z'intungano.
Igihuhusi c´icumi ciswe izina co mu gihe c´ibihuhusi ca Atlantike, Subtropical Storm Jerry, camaze kwiremarema mw´ibahari Atlantike uno musi.
Ingwara yo Gusamara Cane "ni ingwara yo mu bwenge ifise inyabutatu y'ibimenyetso biyiranga birimwo uguhubuka, ugutwarwa n'ukutaguma hamwe canke ukugira umwete urengeje".
Ugeze hejuru kw'isonga urabona neza cane akarere. Aburizi bavuye mu mihingo yose y'isi baguma batanguza inzira nshasha zo kwuririrako ivyo bitandara mu nzira nyinshi rwose zishoboka.
Inyanduruko y'urupfu yavuzwe ko yishwe na kanseri y'akaringoti k'indugwe yo mugitigu.
Si amaleta yose yemera gutanga pasiporo zidatomora igitsina c'umuntu (X) canke inkaratasi ziriko izina rishasha canke igitsina gishasha umuntu yihitiyemwo.
Yamenyekanye cane mu minsi yari muri Atlanta kandi yarashimiwe kubera ukwigisha kwiwe gushasha kwo mu bisagara.
Ubuhinga bwa 802.11n buranyaruka cane gusumba ubwabwitangiye imbere, bikaba vyiyumvirwa ko umuvuduko wabwo ushobora gushika kuri megabite 600 kw'isegonda.
Kugura ibintu ata makori biraguha akaryo ko kugura ibintu bitarihishwa amakori canke amatagisi, mu bibanza bimwebimwe.

Uburyo buboneka neza bwo kugenda mu ndege mu bibanza vya mbere canke vy'abafata ingendo z'akazi ni ukuriha amafaranga menshi cane kuri ako karusho (canke, vyiza gusumba, ugasaba sosiyete ukorera ikabikugirira).
Ingenzi yifitiye akanoti yoshobora kugura iteke y'indege izoyishikana kw'isi yose, ikaza irashikira muri menshi muri ayo mahoteli.
Piquet Jr. yirukanywe inyuma y'Ihiganwa rikuru ryo muri Hongiriya ryabaye mu 2009.
Ubuyapani bugizwe n'amazinga hafi 7.000 (rinini akaba ari Honshu), bigatuma buba izinga rigira 7 kw'isi yose mu bunini!
Ingero nyinshi zimenyerewe (izitwa APS, nk'akarorero) usanga zingana n'izo zindi canke zigomba kungana.
Kigizwe n'amazinga 15 akwiragiye mw'ibahari ahangana n'ibilometero kwadarato birenga imiliyoni 2,2.
Ama photons ni na mato cane ugereranije n'uduhimba tugize ama atome!
Ibikoko vyo mw'ishamba bishobora kugira udusoni canke gukara. Ahantu biba hashobora kuba hakanye, hashushe canke hagoye mu bundi buryo.
Ukwimukira gutangura iyo inrya zagabanutse. Muri iki gihe, ubu bunyegeri burubaka aho burara ariko buza burahindura buri munsi.
Kazino zimwezimwe usanga zitanga inzoga ku buntu. Ariko rero uborewe ntusubira kwiyumvira neza, kandi nta mukinyi mwiza w'akamari ayobewe akamaro ko kugumana ubwenge buri ku murongo.
Casablanca ni kimwe mubibanza atarivyo kuguriramwo ibintu muri Morocco.

Umunyapolitike Al Gore na Jenerali Tommy Franks baravuze, badashavuye, ijambo ry’umutwe bakunda (Iryo Gore akunda ni igihe The Onion yavuga ko we na Tipper bakoranye imibonano mpuzabitsina yambere myiza mu buzima bwabo inyuma yo gutsindwa mu matora yomu 2000).
Iri tegeko ryasomwe ubwa mbere ku mugaragaro na John Nixon mu nzu y’amakoraniro yitiriwe ukwikukira ku wa 8 Mukakaro.
Nk´uko bisanzwe ukwezi kugira inguvu za rukuruzi kw´isi, bigateza imikuba, ni nako rero Milky Way igira inguvu ku kinyenyeri ca Sagittarius.
Yarasubiyemwo, n´aho biri ukwo, ijambo yari yavuze ubwambere ko Roe V. Wade ryari ryo "tegeko ryamaze kwemezwa", ashimangira akamaro k´ingingo za Sentare Nkuru zihuye.
Kenshi usanga vyoroshe kuronka iyindi filime iguheranye, kandi isohora amafoto twovuga ko abona nk'ay'icuma gifotora kigezweho.

Igihe haba amaziko ya Jeff Weise n’abandi batatu muri cenda bapfuye, hakwiragiye amakuru mu karere ka Red Lake uyu munsi avuga yuko uwundi munyeshure yahagaritswe mu bijanye n'ukurasa mw’ishure kwabaye igenekerezo rya 21 Ntwarante.

Ukwemera ibisigabwenge bishobora gutandukanwa n´ukundi kwemera kw´amadini canke ugusenga biciye ku kuntu kwibanda mu vyo umuntu yabayemwo mu gihe yaba mu bihe bitangaje, na cane cane ku bantu b´abanyamahoro, bafise ubumenyi bwinshi, babayeho banezerewe, canke bafise kamere yo kunezerwa cane.
Umuntu apima amapawundi 200 (ibilo 90) kw'isi yoca apima amapawundi nka 36 (ibilo 16) kuri Io. Rero ukwo kwezi ntikwogukwega cane nk'isi.
Ibihe vyose, utegerezwa kubikisha ikibanza ningoga ukoresheje telefone y'iryo shirahamwe.

Leta y'aba Conservatives ya Ositraliya yahahora yaranse gutera umukono kuri Kyoto, ivuga ko vyoca bititura ubutunzi n'ukuntu ibeshejweho cane n'ugushora ibizuku hanze, mu gihe ibihugu nk'Ubuhindi n'Ubushinwa bitahagaritswe n'urugero rutegekanywa rw'imyotsi yonona.
Selile nizo rufatiro mubijanye no kwiga ubuzima kandi ninaco gituma bazita "ibice vyubaka ubuzima".
Ico cegeranyo kiranebagura hafi muri vyose ukuntu ubutegetsi bwaho buvyifatamwo ku vyerekeye Iraki, kikaremesha ko hagira igihindutse mu maguru masha.
Ku wa 24 Nyakanga 1759, Arthur Guinness yarasinye amasezerano yo gupanga y'imyaka 9.000 ku bw'ihinguriro ry'inzoga ryitwa St James' Gate Brewery i Dublin muri Irilande.
Ishirahamwe ry'ubudandaji ryizeye kugwiza amasoko y'inyungu kumenyekana cane mu duce aho Skype yamaze gushinga imizi, nko m'Ubushinwa, Uburaya bwo mu buseruko, no muri Brezile.
Hariya, basanzeyo ikiziga ca Saroja Balasubramanian, imyaka 53, gifutswe n'uburengeti bwuzuye ibikororomvyi vy'amaraso.
Gutembera n'amaguru ni ukugendagenda muca mu bidukikije, kenshi mukabigira muciye mu tuyira bakunda gucamwo.

Bwa muhanuzwajambo w'igihugu mu vy'umutekano, yarafashije Carter mu vy'imigenderanire n'ayandi makungu, nk'akarorero muri ya Masezerano y'i Camp David yo mu 1978, mu vyo kuryohora imigenderanire ya Leta zunze Ubumwe n'Ubushinwa mu mpera z'imyaka ya 1970, mu bijanye n'imigumuko yabaye muri Irani mu 1979 igatuma Abanyamerika bariyo bagirwa imbohe, no mu bijanye n'igitero c'Abasoviyeti muri Afghanistan mu 1979.

Igihe umugwi mutoyi w'ibinyabuzima (ibinyabuzima bikeyi) utandukanijwe n'umugwi nyamukuru waturutsemwo (nk'iyo ivyo binyabuzima bijabutse imisozi canke uruzi, canke iyo vyimukiye kuri rindi zinga ku buryo bibigora gusubira inyuma), kenshi usanga biri ahantu hatandukanye n'aho vyahora.
Nyamugigima yubiriye Mariyana isaha 07:19 z'agatondo zaho (Isaha 09:19 z’ijoro kw'isaha mpuzamukungu ya GMT ku wa gatanu).
Amaakuru ya mbere yavuga ko indege yasubijwe muri Afuganisitani inyuma y'aho ikibuga c'i Ürümqi kiyankiye kugwa vyihuta.
Ico kintu catowe kiradufasha gutahura ingene ihindagurika ry'amoya y'inyoni ryabaye.

Ku wa mbere, abahinga bo kuri kaminuza yitwa Stanford University School of Medicine baratangaje yuko habonetse igikoresho gishasha co gupima indwara gishobora gutandukanya uturemangingo bivanye n'ubwoko bwatwo: ni agakoresho gato cane ka elegitoronike gashobora guhingurwa hakoreshejwe imashini zicapura zirekura irangi, bigashobora gutwara nk'ic'ijana c'idolari rimwe ry'Abanyamerika.

Inama nshingamateka nta bubasha yari ifise bwo gutegeka abantu gutanga amakori. Kubera ko ata rwego rw'ubutegetsi canke rw'ubutungane rwari ruhari ku rwego rw'igihugu, iyo Nama yaca yikora ku batware bo mu maleta atandukanye kugira bashire mu ngiro amategeko yose yashinze, ariko kenshi bakaba batabikora.
Kugira muronke akaryo ko kubona neza Hong Kong, va mwizinga hama mugende ahahanganye na Kowloon.
Sous-marins ni amato yakorewe guca munsi y'amazi, akagumayo igihe kirekire.
Ariko ico kibazo kiriko kirakemurwa kuko haguma hahingurwa imbone z'ivyuma bifotora zihanitse gusumba.
Imbere y’uko abasirikare bashika, Hayiti ntiyigeze ihura n’ingorane zijanye n’iyo ndwara kuva mu myaka ya 1800.
Igihe imiduga yagendera imbere yiwe iri inyuma y'umuduga w'umutekano yaja ku ruhande kunywesha, Alonso yaciye abarengana maze aratsinda.
Nimba waguza amatike y'indege n'uburaro ku bwa 2020 bataratangaza ko vyungurujwe, hari aho utokwororerwa.
Ubwo busumbasumbane bwabonetse ku kwezi hose kandi biboneka ko imvune idakomeye cane, bikerekana ko ivyatumye haba ayo mahinduka ari ivya vuba.
Biraheza bikagaruka mu buraruko biciye mu buseruko, bigasubira kujabuka uruzi Mara, inyuma y'imvura y'amaja muri Ndamukiza.
Ariko iryo tora ribwirizwa kwemezwa na Komite mpuzamakungu iraba ivy'inkino za Olempike yuzuye, mu nama yayo izobera i Copenhague muri Gitugutu.
Bakoze ubushakashatsi bubiri, bumwe aho bateye ADN irimwo fosifore iyindi yari proteyine iteye irimwo sulfora.

Ivyo biremeza iciyumviro gikwiragiye cane c'uko dinozoro zari zifise amoya bikongera bigatanga amakuru ibisigarira bidashobora gutanga, nk'amabara n'imero ivyo bikoko vyari bifise ubiravye impande zose.
Ihayanishwa mpuzamakungu (irikunda kwitwa Ihayanishwa ry'isi yose, canke Ihayanishwa gusa) ni isabukuru mpuzamakungu y'ubuhinga n'utugenegene.

Ufashe urugendo, niwitege ko ibintu biza kuba bitandukanye n'uko biri "iwanyu". Ingene abaho bifata, amategeko, imfungurwa, uruja n'uruza, uburaro, ivyo bisunga, ururimi n'ibindi, usanga bitandukanye n'ivy'iwanyu ku rugero kanaka.
Iyo ivyo binyabuzima bifise inforo itandukanye bavyita Mudasa.
Abitabira mu bikorwa vya minsi yose basanze bakeneye kemenya vyinshi cane bijanye n’itandukaniro ry’ububabare bwo ku mubiri n’ubwo kutiyumva neza.
Ikirekire giteye akaga kirashobora kuba aho ari ho hose kw'isi, kandi kiri ubwoko bwinshi bushobora kuvana n'aho ako karere kari, ingene isi yaho imeze be n'ikirere caho.
Urusengero rwa Artemis rw'i Efeso rwasambutse ku wa 21 Mukakaro 356 M.K. ruturiwe nkana na Érostrate.
Mu kanya gato, abasirikare bafise ibikoresho vyo kurwanya intureka barinjiye ku mbuga baca bazunguruka abafungwa n'ivyotsi bikoroza amosozi.

Amashirahamwe atunganya ingendo yamyeho kuva nko mu kinjana ca 19. Uwukora mu vy'ingendo kenshi aba kirumara igihe ruba ari urugendo rutandukanye n'izo wari umaze kugira, mu bijanye n'akarere uzoba ugiyemwo, imico kama, ururimi canke ibihugu bikenye.
Nimba uzoba uriko ujabuka ikiyaga Baltique co mu Buraruko mu rushana, uzorabe ikibanza co muri kabine, kuko guca mu bibarafu bitera urwamo rwinshi rubuza amahoro abarwumva cane.
Uruzi rwa Amazon ni uruzi rwa kabiri rurerure kandi runini kw’isi. Rutwara amazi arenga incuro 8 ku ruzi rwa kabiri runini.
Ukwinjira muri Afurika y'Epfo n'imodoka ni uburyo bwiza cane bwo kubona ubwiza bwose bwako karere hamwe no kuja mubibanza bitamenyerewe mu ngendo z'ingenzi.
Nimba wipfuza gutembera utarishe menshi kubera amikoro make, canke kubera ko ari ko ubayeho canke wipfuza kubigerageza, hari uburyo bumwebumwe wobikora.
Ibisigarira vy'inyenyeri birashobora kuba vyabaye isoko ryukubaho kwamazi kw'isi vyongeye nutunyabuzima dushobora kuba ndemamubiri hamwe no gufasha ubuzima.
Ivyigwa vyiwe vyerekanye ko iyo inkabuzo itanzwe bishobora gutuma amahaha y'umwana ari munda kwa nyina akomera vyihuse.
Bibiri vya bitatu vy'Abanyavenezuwela bafise akazi usanga bakorera abandi amaserevisi, hafi ica kane bagakorera mu mahinguriro, ica gatanu bagakora ivy'uburimyi.
Gutemberera i Walt Disney World bifatwa nk'urugendo rukuru kumiryango myinshi y'Abanyamerika.
Iyo mwiyumva mwobishobora cane, fata ako karyo kugira mukore umutobe canke muvange imitobe y'ivyamwa bitandukanye:
Kimwe coco, mu buraruko bwa Nouveau-Mexique hari ingorane zikomeye zijanye n'abatwara umuduga baborewe, kandi benshi muri bo ni abo mu micungararo y'ububare bwo mu dusagara dutoyi.
Abenshi bahasiga ubuzima kubera baruhishwa no kugerageza kwoga bahunga uwo mukuba, kandi ushobora gusanga bidashoboka.
Giancarlo Fisichella vyaramugoye kuyobora imodoka yiwe aca aheza ihiganwa inyuma gatoyi yo gutangura.
I Whistler (ahagenzwa isaha 1 n'inusu uvuye i Vancouver mu muduga) harazimvye mugabo harazwi cane kubera amahiganwa ya Jeux olympiques d'hiver yo mu 2010.
Gutembera mu bwato ni uburyo bwo kuryoherwa muri Finilande, aho usanga hari ubwato bumwe ku bantu indwi canke umunani.
Ntawundi muntu yigeze aja munkino canke ngo atsindire umugwi gusumvya Bobek.
Mu 1989 yafashije gukora "Les Simpsons" arikumwe na Brooks na Groening, kandi niwe yari ajejwe guha akazi umugwi wambere w’abayanditse.

Kandi ntagisabwa gihari co kuronka inimero yaho uri ivuye mumugwi mubamwo; mushobora kuronka ubuhinga ngurukana bumenyi buvuye kukigendajuru mugahinga ka Chicken, Alaska hama hitemwo inimero ivuga ko muri musi y' izuba rya Arizona.
Iryo dini ryatangujwe mu kinjana ca 15 n'umwigisha mukuru Nanak (1469-1539). Hakwirikiye abigisha bakuru icenda bagiye bakurakuranwa.

Yashitse kuri iyi ncamake bitewe n'ivyivyumviro vyinshi vyiza no gushigikirwa yashikirijwe n'abagabo n'abagore bose hamwe bahimiriza ko uburyo bwo gutandukanya imvyaro bubwirizwa gufatwa nk'ubuvuzi nkenerwa.
Iyo rero abagize ishirahamwe bakoreye hamwe kugira batsinde intambamyi kanaka, birashobora gutuma hiyumvirwa uburyo bushasha bwo gukora butuma abakiriya bitwararikwa.

Ariko ibibanza vy'amakazino nka vyose vyavuzwe haruguru bitanga ibinyobwa, kandi mu bitari bike muri vyo usanga hari ivyo kwisamaza bisohorwa n'amashirahamwe kanaka (canecane ibibanza bininibinini vyegereye Albuquerque na Santa Fe).

Kubera ko amoya ya dinozoro adafise agati k'umugongo gakomeye mugabo akaba afise utundi duhimba tw'amoya, nk'udushami n'udushamishami, abashakashatsi bashitse ku ciyumviro c'uko agati k'umugogo k'amoya kabonetse mw'ihindagurika inyuma y'utwo duhimba tundi.
Bisubiye, amategeko y' akarere ntangaruka afise na nto kukwimura kutemewe n' amategeko; iyimurwa igiharuro kukindi giharuro rya disike rikora neza ku cuma icarico cose aho icakame gikora.
Iyerekanwa kenshi ryaco mumuziki, amareresi, inyandiko no mumigenzo vyarafashije igisagara n'ivyibutso vyaco kumenyekana kw'isi yose.
Argentina irazwi cane mu kugira umwe mumigwi myiza hamwe n' abakinyi ba polo kw' isi.
Guhera 1966, ama Sundarbans cabaye ikibanza kidasanzwe c' ibidukikije, kandi hagereranywa ko ubu harimwo ingwe 400 z'Ubwami bwa Bengal hamwe n' imparage 30.000 zabonywe muri ako karere.
Muri ukwo kwezi nyene, iyindi ndege nini itwara abantu yarataye inzira i Mashhad iseka uruhome, ihitana abantu cumi n'indwi.

Mu mayinga make aheze, inyuma y´amakuru yashizwe ahabona n´umumenyeshamakuru Makis Triantafylopoulos mu kiganiro ciwe co ku Mboneshakure gikunzwe cane "Zoungla" kuri Mboneshakure Alpha, umushingamateka akaba n´umushingwamanza, Petros Mantouvalos yaratanze imihoho kuko abakozi b´ibiro vyiwe bari begwa n´uguharanira inyungu zabo bwite n´ukurya ibiturire.
Nubwo basa n'abarushe cane rwose mu rukino rwabahuza na bagenzi babo bo mu bumanuko, abakinyi ba Afrika y’epfo bagumye batera intambwe uko ihiganwa ryabandanya.
Hisunzwe urwo rubanza, imicafu y’ikambi y’Ishirahamwe mpuzamakungu ONU ntiyasukuwe nk'uko vyategerezwa, bituma haba imigera yinjira mu ruzi Arubonite, rumwe mu nzuzi ndende z’igihugu ca Hayiti.
Abateguye imyiyerekano bavuze ko yitabwe n'abantu nka 100.000 mu bisagara vy'Ubudagi nka Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg na Hanover.
Ivyifashisho bitaboneka biba biri indani muri porogaramu yo ku nyabwonko kandi biba bigenewe kubaza, gutanguza canke gusigura intambwe zoba zabaye izigoranye cane kwikorana ku munyeshure.
NextGen nubuhinga kubwa FAA, bufasha indege kwirukanga amabarabara magufi hamwe no kuziganya ama miliyoni yingunguru z'ibitoro kumwaka hamwe no kugabanya irekurwa ry'ivyuka vyonona ikirere.
Ibi vyaciye bimenyerwa cane, ariko ico cuma caciye gituma amapine y’imikogote bayashirako ibindi bintu.
Mu gihe wontembera muri Arktike canke muri Antarktike mu gihe gikanye uzobona ijoro ryo ku masonga y'isi, bisigura ko izuba ritaduga mu kirere.
Uko ico gitigiri citiriwe Rossby c'inyenyeri kiba gito, ni ko bishika gake hakaba uguhindagurika kw'ubushobozi bwayo bwo gukwega canke gusunika ibintu nk'isumaku.
Ukunanirwa kw'iryungane rya kabiri, ritegekanya kubuza ukwubaka imbere y'amategeko y'ababana basangiye ibitsina, gushobora kwugururira imiryango ukubaka imbere y'amategeko muri kazoza.
Bwarubwanbere, mumwaka uheze, Ubushinwa bushoye hanze amamodoka menshi gusumvya Ubudagi bukanacako Leta Zunze Ubumwe nk'isoko nkuru kuriryo hinguriro.
Iyo raporo yerekanye ingene amanota y’ibibazo yaduze cane ku rugero rutangaje ko kandi ishure ryabibonye ntirikore na kimwe.
Menya kandi ko akamoto gakwega amadubu n'ibindi bikoko. Rero wirinde kugendana canke guteka imfungurwa zimota cane, kandi wamane isuku kw'ihema ryawe.

Aho ntihakunze kuba harimwo iyo bita ski de randonnée canke iyitwa ski-alpinisme zo mu misozi mugabo birafitaniye isano, izikunda kugirwa ahantu hahanamye kandi zigasaba gukoresha ibirato vya ski bikomeye gusumba.
